benchmarks.title: Benchmarks
benchmarks.placeholder: Here you will start and compare evaluation runs. It arrives in a later release.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not exist in the app.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This screen could not be shown.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the account that the engine's administrator gave you.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {{seconds}} s and try again.
login.rateLimitedNoWait: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
login.unavailable: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.

change.title: Change your password
change.description: Your password is temporary. Choose a new one to continue.
change.hint: At least {{min}} characters and different from your username.
change.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
change.failed: The password could not be changed. Try again.

errors.sameAsUsername: It cannot be the same as your username.
errors.sameAsCurrent: It must be different from the current one.

menu.label: {{name}}'s account
menu.logoutFailed: Could not sign out. Try again.

ask.intro: Ask a question about the papers in the corpus. The answer cites its sources: click a citation to read the paper at that page. Questions and answers stay in this tab and are not saved on the server.

form.label: Your question
form.placeholder: For example: What limits T1 in transmons?
form.hint: Press Ctrl+Enter to send. At most {{max}} characters.
form.blank: Write a question to send it.
form.busy: A question is being answered. Wait for it or cancel it to send another.
form.engineDown: The engine reports a problem, so Ask is off. Use Ask anyway if the cause may be fixed.
form.starting: The engine is starting, so Ask is off for a few seconds.

options.title: Options
options.description: They apply to the questions you send until you reset them. Each option can also stay on the server's own setting.

useIndex.label: Search with the index
useIndex.help: Off: the answering model looks through the whole corpus itself, which is slow.

bm25.label: Keyword matching
bm25.help: When keyword matching joins the vector search.

wholeBlocks.label: Complete equations and tables
wholeBlocks.help: Complete the equation, code block or table that a passage cuts.

warming.title: The engine is starting
warming.body: Questions can be sent in a few seconds.

unavailable.title: The engine reports a problem
unavailable.body: {{reason}} Ask is off while this lasts. If the cause may be fixed, use Ask anyway.
unavailable.noReason: Ask is off while this lasts. If the cause may be fixed, use Ask anyway.

unreachable.title: The service cannot be reached
unreachable.body: Check that the API is running. Questions will fail until it answers.

answer.title: Answer
answer.timings: Searched in {{retrieve}} s, answered in {{answer}} s ({{wall}} s in all).
answer.timingsNoSearch: Answered in {{answer}} s, without the index.
answer.openCitation: Open the paper at this citation

contexts.title: What the model read
contexts.none: No passages came with this answer.

title.503: The service cannot answer right now
title.502: A model server returned an error

failure.network: The connection to the service was lost while waiting for the answer.
failure.lost: The service no longer has this question. It keeps them for 30 minutes.
failure.malformed: The service sent something this page does not understand.

history.title: This session
history.note: Kept in this tab only. Closing the tab or signing out erases them.

source.notFound: This page is not in the paper.
source.ambiguous: That short id names more than one paper.
source.error: The page could not be loaded.

sets.intro: Browse the question sets, edit the items of a draft, review them, import and export files, and freeze a version when it is ready. Items follow the qset/1 format; the server checks every change.

catalog.title: Sets and versions
catalog.description: Every version of every set. A draft can still change; a frozen version is fixed and has the md5 that runs name.
catalog.empty: There are no question sets yet. Make an empty draft or import a file below.
catalog.breakdown: Accepted: {{accepted}}, needs a second reviewer: {{needsSecond}}, edited: {{edited}}, rejected: {{rejected}}

new.title: New draft
new.description: Start an empty draft, or make the next version of a set as a copy of one of its versions.
new.copyHint: The copy becomes the next version of {{name}}, with no decisions.
new.name: Name
new.nameHint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; it starts with a letter or digit.
new.nameRule: Use letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, starting with a letter or digit (64 at most).
new.corpusHint: The corpus that new items name when they leave it out. Optional.

import.title: Import a file
import.description: A qset/1 file (plain or gzip), or a file of an older shape. It becomes a new draft; nothing is kept unless the whole file is valid.
import.tooBig: The file is over 20 MiB, which the server refuses.
import.shapeHint: A qset/1 file is stored as it is.
import.corpusHint: This older shape names no corpus, so the items get this one.
import.name: Set name
import.nameHint: Optional. The name in the file's header is used when this is empty.
import.versionHint: Optional, like v3. The next free one is used when this is empty.
import.refused: The file was not imported. Fix the lines below and try again.

version.title: Version
version.draftNote: A draft: the owner or an admin edits it, and any member reviews its items.
version.frozenNote: Frozen: its items, reviews and md5 never change. Runs name it by its md5.
version.exported: Saved {{filename}}. The server sends the version as stored, byte for byte, and names its md5 as {{md5}}.

items.title: Items
items.description: Filters are kept in the address, so a filtered list can be shared.
items.none: This version has no items yet.
items.caption: Items {{first}} to {{last}} of {{total}}
items.question: Question

item.frozenNote: This version is frozen, so the item cannot change.
item.cannotAdd: Only the owner ({{owner}}) or an admin can add items to this draft, and only while it is a draft.

editor.title: Edit the item
editor.description: Save replaces the item. The server checks it against qset/1 and shows each problem at its field.
editor.proposeOnly: Only the owner ({{owner}}) or an admin can save changes to this draft. You can propose your changes as an edit decision in the review below.
editor.wholeItemHint: The same item as the fields show it. Changes here appear in the fields.
editor.mustBeObject: This must be a JSON object.
editor.cannotUse: {{field}} cannot be used as written. Fix it before saving, checking or deciding.
editor.idHint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen. It cannot change later.
editor.mirrorOfHint: The id of the item this one translates. Needed when the origin is mirror.
editor.question: Question
editor.answerVerifyHint: A verify question is answered yes or no.
editor.keyFactsHint: What a good answer must contain. A number has a relative tolerance; text and expressions may list other accepted spellings.
editor.factAlts: Other accepted spellings of key fact {{number}}
editor.factPaperHint: Optional: the 16-character document id the fact comes from.
editor.goldPapersHint: A list of papers with their doc_id and passages. A question with no answer in the corpus has none.
editor.necessityHint: For each paper (doc_id), the numbers of the passages the answer needs.
editor.circuitHint: The circuit the item is about: wires, gates, the target and how equality is judged.
editor.searchRecordHint: How the absence of an answer was checked: the corpus and the search terms.
editor.otherHint: Fields without a control above, such as choices, confusers, writer or ext.
editor.hiddenProblems: Problems at parts this form does not show
editor.valid: The item is a valid qset/1 item. Nothing was saved.
editor.deleteBody: The item leaves this draft. Its decisions stay in the history, and its id cannot be used again in this version.
editor.staleBody: Someone saved or reviewed this draft after you opened this item, so your save was not applied. Load the latest version (your edits are discarded), or keep your edits on top of the latest version and save again.
editor.kept: The latest version was read. Your edits are kept; save again to apply them.
editor.loaded: The latest version was loaded. Your edits were dropped.
editor.decisionsBody: People have already decided on this text, so it is fixed. Propose your change as an edit decision instead; it is applied when the version is frozen.
editor.proposeInstead: Propose these changes as an edit decision
editor.remoteTitle: This item changed while you had it open
editor.remoteBody: Someone else changed {{fields}}. You had no edits, so the editor now shows the latest text. Read it before you save or decide.
editor.behindTitle: This item changed while you were editing
editor.behindBody: Someone else changed {{fields}}. Your edits are not lost, but nothing is saved or decided until you choose: merge your edits onto the latest version, or load the latest and drop them.
editor.behindBoth: You also changed {{fields}}. After a merge your value is kept for those, and you can take the other value.
editor.behindUnreadable: This item changed while a box of JSON cannot be read. Fix that box to merge your edits, or load the latest and drop them.
editor.loadLatestDrop: Load the latest and drop my edits
editor.mergedLatest: Taken from the latest version because you had not changed them: {{fields}}.
editor.mergedConflicts: You and someone else both changed these fields. Your value is in the editor.
editor.cannotSwitch: Fix it before you change the view: the text would be lost.
editor.leaveBody: If you leave this page your edits are lost. Stay to save them, or leave and drop them.

review.title: Review
review.description: Accept, propose an edit or reject. A decision is recorded against the draft you read, with your name and the date.
review.noHistory: Nobody has decided on this item yet.
review.noteHint: Required for an edit and a reject; optional for an accept.
review.noteRequired: Write a note: an edit or a reject needs one.
review.noChanges: You have not changed any field, so there is nothing to propose as an edit.
review.removedIgnored: Removing a field cannot be proposed, so these are left out: {{fields}}.
review.blocked: {{field}} cannot be used as written, so no decision can be sent.
review.staleTitle: The draft changed while you were reading
review.staleBody: Someone changed the draft after you opened this item, so the decision was not recorded. The item was read again. Check it, then decide again; your note is still here.
review.earlierDraft: Decided on an earlier state of the draft

explain.needs_second: Accepted by {{names}}. A different person must accept it too before it counts as gold.
explain.edited: The latest decision is an edit proposed by {{by}}; freezing applies it.
explain.rejected: The latest decision is a rejection by {{by}}; freezing removes this item.

review.unsavedNote: Accept and reject are about the item as it is saved. Your unsaved changes only go with a proposed edit.
review.remoteChanged: The text above changed while you had it open ({{fields}}). Check it before you decide.
review.waiting: The item changed on the server and you have edits. Choose above how to go on; no decision can be sent until then.

freeze.title: Freeze {{name}} {{version}}
freeze.planDescription: Freezing applies the latest decision on each item and closes the version for good. Read the plan, then freeze.
freeze.counts: The draft has {{before}} items; the frozen version will have {{after}}.

group.stale: Decided on an earlier state of the draft
group.unknown: Decisions about items the draft no longer has

groupHelp.accepted: The latest decision is an accept.
groupHelp.edited: The proposed fields replace the ones in the item.
groupHelp.rejected: These items are not in the frozen file.
groupHelp.needs_second: Still kept, but only one person accepted them.
groupHelp.stale: The draft changed after these decisions were made.
groupHelp.unknown: These items were deleted; their decisions are ignored.

freeze.staleBody: A stale decision was made before the draft last changed. It still applies: an item with decisions keeps its text, so what the reviewer read is what is frozen.
freeze.confirmBody: The version will have {{after}} of its {{before}} items and can never change again. To go on, start a next version from it.
freeze.changedTitle: A decision or an item changed
freeze.changedBody: The draft changed after you read the plan, so nothing was frozen. Read the plan again before you freeze.
freeze.doneMd5: The md5 of the frozen file is
freeze.doneCounts: It has {{after}} of the {{before}} items of the draft.
freeze.notYoursTitle: Only the owner or an admin freezes a draft

problem.errorId: Error id for the server log: {{id}}

status.400: The request could not be read
status.428: The version you read is missing

circuits.intro: Paste the code of a circuit from a paper, see the gates the reader found, simulate it and check it against a state, a unitary or another circuit. Nothing here leaves your machines.

input.title: Circuit
input.description: Paste LaTeX (quantikz, Qcircuit, yquant or tikz-cd) or a circuit/1 document.
input.latexHint: The body of one code block. The reader lists every gate it understands and every part it does not. Press Ctrl+Enter to read.
input.jsonHint: Used as written: wires are numbered from 1, top to bottom. A key written twice is refused. Press Ctrl+Enter to read.

reading.title: Gate list

explain.parsed: Every part of the drawing was understood.
explain.partial: Some parts of the drawing were not understood. The simulator refuses a circuit with unread parts.
explain.unparsed: No circuit was found in this text.

reading.wiresPlain: Wires: {{count}}, numbered from 1 at the top.
reading.captionOne: Gates of circuit {{n}}, left to right
reading.captionLeft: Circuit {{n}}, left side of the equality
reading.unreadBody: These parts of the drawing were not understood, so the circuit cannot be simulated until they are removed or rewritten.
reading.nothing: There is no circuit to show.

run.title: Simulate
run.description: The final state and the outcome probabilities, up to 12 wires.
run.inputHint: A basis label such as 010 (wire 1 first) or a list of amplitudes such as [0, 1]. Empty means all wires in 0.
run.valuesHint: One per line, name = value. A value is a number or an angle such as \pi/2.
run.unitary: Also show the unitary (up to 8 wires)

check.title: Check
check.description: Is the circuit equal to a target, up to a global phase?

hint.state: A basis label such as 11 or a list of amplitudes of norm 1, for example [0.7071, 0, 0, 0.7071].
hint.unitary: A square matrix as a list of rows. Each entry is a number or a pair [re, im].
hint.circuit: LaTeX of one circuit, or a circuit/1 document starting with {.

check.drawnHint: Compares the two sides of the equality drawn in the circuit, left against right.
check.drawnNone: The circuit read has no equality drawn in it.

result.refusedBody: The simulator did not run this circuit, so there is no result. These are its reasons.
result.symbolicBody: The circuit has symbols with no value: {{names}}. Give each a value and simulate again.
result.addNames: Add the names to the values
result.stateCaption: Final state (wires: {{wires}}). Wire 1 is the most significant bit.
result.noState: The state is not listed for a circuit of this size.
result.corner: Showing the top left {{shown}} by {{shown}} of {{size}} by {{size}}.
result.seeConventions: See the conventions and the gate table

live.equal: Check finished: equal up to global phase.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.ofResult: As stated in the last result.
conventions.ofSimulator: What the simulator assumes. Every result repeats them.
conventions.unavailable: The conventions could not be loaded.
conventions.limits: The simulator itself takes up to {{statevector}} wires for a state, {{unitary}} for a unitary and {{ops}} operations.
conventions.apiCaps: This screen is for small circuits: up to 12 wires, or 8 for a unitary or for a comparison of two circuits. For larger ones use the quantum-sim command line.
conventions.gateTableCaption: Gates the simulator knows, by name

problem.unprocessable: The circuit could not be processed
problem.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this
problem.malformed: The server's answer could not be read

invalidJson.title: Not valid JSON
invalidJson.detail: The text is not valid JSON. Check the commas and the brackets.

duplicateKey.title: A key is written twice
duplicateKey.detail: The key "{{key}}" appears twice in one object. The text does not say which value is meant, so it is refused.

notACircuit.title: Not a circuit/1 document
notACircuit.detail: A circuit/1 document needs a number of wires and a list of parts.

notRead.title: Read the circuit first
notRead.detail: Press Read circuit, then simulate or check.

badValues.title: A parameter value is not valid
badValues.detail: Line {{line}} ({{name}}): write name = value, once per name.

badState.title: The state is not valid
badState.detail: Write a basis label such as 010, or a list of amplitudes such as [0, 1].

badUnitary.title: The unitary is not valid
badUnitary.detail: Write a matrix as a list of rows, for example [[0, 1], [1, 0]].

emptyTarget.title: No target given
emptyTarget.detail: Write what to compare the circuit with.

secondUnread.title: The second circuit was not read
secondUnread.detail: No circuit was found in the second text.

secondMany.title: More than one circuit in the second text
secondMany.detail: The second text holds {{count}} circuits. Keep one.

network.title: The server could not be reached
network.detail: Check the connection and try again.
